definitions: A political philosophy that originated in 19th-century Britain.
It opposes the disestablishment of the Church of England.
The movement was against proposals to remove the Anglican Church's status as the state church of England, Ireland, and Wales.
examples: The word antidisestablishmentarianism is one of the longest in the English language.
The debate over antidisestablishmentarianism was significant in Victorian politics.
She used antidisestablishmentarianism in her speech to make a point about long words.
